Inpatient visits (concept_id 9201) are the hospitalization unit. Now let me build the analysis. Index stroke = first inpatient visit with a stroke condition; readmission = any subsequent inpatient visit within 6 months (≤182 days). Then compare comorbidity prevalence between readmitted vs non-readmitted.

First, let me size the index-stroke inpatient cohort using the cerebral-infarction descendant hierarchy.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH stroke_dx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (443454, 4110190, 372924, 4046362, 4110186)
),
stroke_inpt AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, vo.visit_occurrence_id, vo.visit_start_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON vo.visit_occurrence_id = co.visit_occurrence_id
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM stroke_dx)
    AND vo.visit_concept_id = 9201
),
idx AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(visit_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM stroke_inpt
  GROUP BY person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       MIN(index_date) AS earliest,
       MAX(index_date) AS latest
FROM idx;

15,396 index-stroke inpatients. Now let me compute the 6-month readmission rate, then run the comorbidity association analysis. I'll require a clean cohort (index ≥ 2010, an observation window allowing 182 days of follow-up) to make readmission ascertainment valid.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH stroke_dx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (443454, 4110190, 372924, 4046362, 4110186)
),
stroke_inpt AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(vo.visit_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON vo.visit_occurrence_id = co.visit_occurrence_id
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM stroke_dx)
    AND vo.visit_concept_id = 9201
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
idx AS (
  SELECT si.person_id, si.index_date
  FROM stroke_inpt si
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = si.person_id
  WHERE si.index_date >= '2010-01-01'
    AND DATEADD(day,182,si.index_date) <= op.observation_period_end_date
    AND si.index_date >= op.observation_period_start_date
),
readmit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.person_id
  FROM idx i
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON vo.person_id = i.person_id
  WHERE vo.visit_concept_id = 9201
    AND vo.visit_start_date > i.index_date
    AND vo.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day,182,i.index_date)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM idx) AS cohort_n,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM readmit) AS readmitted_n;

  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM stroke_dx)

),
idx AS (

  WHERE si.index_date >= '2010-01-01'
    AND DATEADD(day,182,si.index_date) <= op.observation_period_end_date

),

),
